1	import { z } from "zod";
2	import {
3	  AUTH_BASE_URL_MODES,
4	  BIND_MODES,
5	  DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURES,
6	  DEPLOYMENT_MODES,
7	  DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORMS,
8	  SECRET_PROVIDERS,
9	  STORAGE_PROVIDERS,
10	} from "./constants.js";
11	import { validateConfiguredBindMode } from "./network-bind.js";
12	
13	export const configMetaSchema = z.object({
14	  version: z.literal(1),
15	  updatedAt: z.string(),
16	  source: z.enum(["onboard", "configure", "doctor"]),
17	});
18	
19	export const llmConfigSchema = z.object({
20	  provider: z.enum(["claude", "openai"]),
21	  apiKey: z.string().optional(),
22	});
23	
24	export const databaseBackupConfigSchema = z.object({
25	  enabled: z.boolean().default(true),
26	  intervalMinutes: z.number().int().min(1).max(7 * 24 * 60).default(60),
27	  retentionDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(3650).default(7),
28	  dir: z.string().default("~/.paperclip/instances/default/data/backups"),
29	});
30	
31	export const databaseConfigSchema = z.object({
32	  mode: z.enum(["embedded-postgres", "postgres"]).default("embedded-postgres"),
33	  connectionString: z.string().optional(),
34	  embeddedPostgresDataDir: z.string().default("~/.paperclip/instances/default/db"),
35	  embeddedPostgresPort: z.number().int().min(1).max(65535).default(54329),
36	  backup: databaseBackupConfigSchema.default({
37	    enabled: true,
38	    intervalMinutes: 60,
39	    retentionDays: 7,
40	    dir: "~/.paperclip/instances/default/data/backups",
41	  }),
42	});
43	
44	export const loggingConfigSchema = z.object({
45	  mode: z.enum(["file", "cloud"]),
46	  logDir: z.string().default("~/.paperclip/instances/default/logs"),
47	});
48	
49	export const serverConfigSchema = z.object({
50	  deploymentMode: z.enum(DEPLOYMENT_MODES).default("local_trusted"),
51	  deploymentPlatform: z.enum(DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORMS).default("node"),
52	  exposure: z.enum(DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURES).default("private"),
53	  bind: z.enum(BIND_MODES).optional(),
54	  customBindHost: z.string().optional(),
55	  host: z.string().default("127.0.0.1"),
56	  port: z.number().int().min(1).max(65535).default(3100),
57	  allowedHostnames: z.array(z.string().min(1)).default([]),
58	  serveUi: z.boolean().default(true),
59	});
60
